chunks: May Allah bless a man who hears a point of wisdom and retains it,
when he is invited to the right path he approaches it, he follows a leader (by catching his waist band) and finds salvation,
keeps Allah before his eyes and fears his sins, performs actions sincerely and acts virtuously,
earns treasure of heavenly rewards, avoids vice,
aims at (good) objective and reaps recompense,
faces his desires and rejects (fake) hopes,
makes endurance the means to his salvation and piety the provision for his death,
rides on the path of honour and sticks to the highway of truth,
makes good use of his time and hastens towards end and takes with him the provision of (good) actions.

key_terms.حُجْزَةِ هَادٍ: waist band of a guide (symbolizing following authority)

ai.seo_question: What are the key spiritual qualities for salvation according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) uses the metaphor of the 'white path' (al-mahajja al-bayda') to describe the clear, distinct way of the righteous, urging believers to seize the opportunity of life before death arrives. This reflects the Shia emphasis on *mubashara* (hastening) in good deeds and the concept of *sabr* as the vehicle for salvation, aligning with the tradition of balancing hope and fear in one's spiritual journey.
